surface_pressure_rel_l2.label: Surface pressure rel. L2 (area-weighted)
surface_pressure_rel_l2.description: Area-weighted relative L2 error for surface pressure; each scored surface point is weighted by its benchmark-supplied represented area. Lower is better.

surface_pressure_rel_l1.description: Area-weighted relative L1 error for surface pressure. Lower is better.

surface_pressure_mae.description: Area-weighted mean absolute error for surface pressure. Lower is better.

surface_pressure_rmse.description: Area-weighted root-mean-square error for surface pressure. Lower is better.

surface_wall_shear_mae.description: Area-weighted mean absolute error for surface wall shear. Lower is better.

surface_wall_shear_rmse.description: Area-weighted root-mean-square error for surface wall shear. Lower is better.

relative_l1_l2.aggregation: form each complete-case ratio from additive sufficient statistics, then macro-average all cases in the selected split equally

dimensional_mae_rmse.surface_pressure: inverse-scale each case by q_inf into Pa
dimensional_mae_rmse.surface_wall_shear: inverse-scale each case by q_inf into Pa
dimensional_mae_rmse.volume_pressure: inverse-scale each case by q_inf into Pa
dimensional_mae_rmse.volume_velocity: inverse-scale each case by |U_inf| into m/s
dimensional_mae_rmse.aggregation: derive each dimensional complete-case value before macro-averaging all cases in the selected split equally

vector_reduction.relative_l2: one nodal weight multiplies the squared three-component vector error and truth magnitude
vector_reduction.mae_rmse: current native-evaluator per-component convention over 3*N weighted scalar components

candidate_migration_notes: The closed schema-v3 candidate removes the legacy diagnostic volume_velocity_physical_rel_l2 and volume_pressure_physical_rel_l2 requirements. The native Table-5 evaluator has never published or consumed volume dual-volume support; its frozen primary contract is equal valid native nodes. This candidate migration is not an activated public scoring change because submissions remain closed and unapproved.

Relative field metrics are bound to the frozen Table-5 nondimensional targets, while the existing paper-compatible MAE/RMSE metrics remain dimensional. A candidate aggregate must emit and audit both bases from the same per-case inference stream.

The closed candidate replaces the stale prototype 16-station velocity panel with the five frozen Table-5 stations B.2, B.3, C.1, C.2, and C.3. Velocity profiles use physical polyline arc length and within-station centering; Cp retains exact rows A-J with physical connected-cut arc length and independently centered connected graphs. This is not an activated public profile-contract change while submissions remain closed.
